decisions_after_reply.ENTITLEMENT_ACCEPTED_PROCEED_TO_HISTORIC: All HARD blockers PASS (or CONDITIONAL retention only) and quote in scope: request evaluation sample, then entitled backfill.
decisions_after_reply.ENTITLEMENT_CONDITIONAL_REQUEST_CLARIFIC: Any CONDITIONAL without a FAIL: ask the narrow written follow-up defined in that row before any purchase.
decisions_after_reply.ENTITLEMENT_REJECTED: Any HARD blocker FAIL, or research/backtest use prohibited, or quote out of scope: stop NYSE path and trigger NASDAQ_CBOE_CONTINGENCY.md.

matrix.conditional: Original file plus separately timestamped corrections replayable to the same knowledge state; requires proof that no silent overwrites occur.
matrix.fail: Only today's retrospectively corrected reconstruction with no correction-arrival history.
matrix.pass: Historical file is the exact original distributed state, or original state plus separately timestamped corrections.

matrix.conditional: None: gaps must be dated, explained, and outside the canonical trading calendar, else FAIL.
matrix.fail: History starts materially later than the first 2016 canonical research date, or bulk backfill unavailable.
matrix.pass: Complete full+delta coverage begins no later than 2015-12-16 / first 2016 canonical research date.

matrix.conditional: Vendor documents the exact corporate-action list that mints new numbers AND supplies predecessor/successor links; else FAIL.
matrix.fail: Symbol is the primary identity, or Stock Numbers are reused so ticker-reuse issues cannot be separated.
matrix.pass: Issue-level persistent Stock Number resolves ticker reuse and class/symbol changes.

matrix.conditional: Non-Arca leveraged/inverse covered by a documented supplement path with its own vintage proof; else FAIL for the ETP slice.
matrix.fail: No useful historical product/security type: ordinary/company securities cannot be separated from ETFs/ETNs/preferred/warrants/units.
matrix.pass: Historical Security Type + Issuer Type (+ ETP fields where applicable) separate ordinary common from ADR/REIT/ETF/ETN/preferred/warrant/right/unit.

matrix.fail: License prohibits internal historical backtesting or derived internal classification.
matrix.pass: Internal quantitative research, backtesting, and derived internal classification expressly permitted.

matrix.conditional: Original files must be destroyed at termination BUT reproducible derived effective-dated classifications (no raw vendor fields) may legally remain. Record impact: re-entitlement needed for byte-level re-audit.
matrix.fail: No legal path to store files or retain derived tables even while subscribed.
matrix.pass: Raw files, checksums, backups, and derived tables storable while subscribed; post-termination terms explicit.

matrix.conditional: Identifier surcharge disclosed and in scope; removal obligations explicit.
matrix.fail: CUSIP/ISIN/Stock Number storage for the stated use is prohibited or encumbered beyond scope.
matrix.pass: CUSIP/ISIN/Stock Number storable for one-user internal research with no extra blocking license.

matrix.conditional: Evaluation files differ only in stated redactions and are marked as such.
matrix.fail: No historical evaluation sample with full+delta pairs available.
matrix.pass: 4-8 date evaluation sample with full+delta pairs, byte-identical to archive files.

matrix.conditional: Quote valid for a bounded window with stated scope; record expiry.
matrix.fail: Quote requires redistribution tier or exceeds authorized research budget with no single-user option.
matrix.pass: One-user internal-research quote (backfill + updates + identifier fees) within scope.

no_weakening_rule: Do not weaken HARD blockers after seeing a quote. A low price never converts a FAIL to a PASS.
